pages.title: Knuckles the Echidna Standing with His Spiked Fists Raised Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles the Echidna stands with his spiked fists raised in this printable coloring page, facing forward with a slight smirk and his feet set apart. His long head quills frame the crescent marking on his chest. The coloring sheet uses bold outlines and broad open areas, with smaller sections around glove spikes and the studs on his oversized shoes.

pages.title: Knuckles Guarding the Master Emerald at the Angel Island Shrine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Knuckles guarding the Master Emerald at the Angel Island shrine, standing on stone steps in front of the large faceted gem. Cracked columns and block walls rise behind his spiked gloves and heavy shoes. The coloring sheet contrasts the emerald's sharp geometric sections with broad character shapes and irregular masonry.

pages.title: Knuckles Confronting Dr. Eggman as He Steals the Master Emerald Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles confronts Dr. Eggman as he steals the Master Emerald in this printable coloring page, raising his spiked fists beneath Eggman's hovering round vehicle. A jointed claw grips the faceted emerald above the shrine steps. Eggman's wide mustache, circular craft panels, cracked stone blocks, and zigzag pedestal pattern provide distinctive details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Knuckles Driving the Land Breaker in Team Sonic Racing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Knuckles driving the Land Breaker in Team Sonic Racing, gripping the steering wheel as the chunky vehicle follows a curving track. Large treaded tires, exposed suspension springs, and rows of round headlights define the car. Cliffs, flat-topped trees, and a trackside barrier add background shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Movie Knuckles Sliding Down the Snowy Mountain on His Feet While Chasing Sonic Coloring Page
pages.description: Movie Knuckles chases Sonic down a snowy mountain in this printable coloring page, sliding on his feet behind Sonic as he rides a snowboard. Snow sprays around their shoes, and sharp peaks rise behind the sloping trail. The coloring sheet combines broad snow and character sections with glove spikes, shoe straps, and small scattered snow clumps.

pages.title: Knuckles the Echidna Sonic the Hedgehog Power Coloring Page
pages.description: A spiky-haired cartoon fighter reaches forward in this printable coloring page, extending an oversized gloved fist beneath focused eyes while bending one leg behind the body. Long swept hair shapes frame a small smile and triangular nose. Broad wrist cuffs, curved shoe soles, rounded fingers, and simple clothing outlines define the energetic character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Knuckles Jumping on Alien Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles jumps above an alien landscape in this printable coloring page, raising his spiked fists and spreading his large shoes as he bounds forward. Craters, jagged rock formations, a crystal cluster, and unusual plants sit beneath a ringed planet and two smaller moons.

pages.title: Knuckles Walking in City Escape Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles walks confidently through City Escape in this printable coloring page, stepping along a sidewalk with his gloved fists hanging beside his body. A railing, curved road, streetlights, route signs, and buildings with rows of windows fill the detailed city background.

pages.title: Knuckles Pointing in Island Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles points toward an island village across the water in this printable coloring page, smiling beside the shoreline with one gloved arm extended. A winding path connects thatched huts and a central building, with palm trees, hillside bushes, and a wooden dock completing the view.

pages.title: Knuckles Walking in Rooftop Run Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles walks along a rooftop in Rooftop Run in this printable coloring page, taking a long stride above a city filled with tall buildings. Roof tiles, pipes, ventilation units, chimneys, antennas, and a water tower offer smaller details around his bold figure.

pages.title: Knuckles Posing in Ocean Shore Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles poses on an ocean shore in this printable coloring page, holding his spiked gloves together in front of his chest with a confident smile. Foamy waves, sandy curves, scattered pebbles, distant cliffs, and broad clouds create the calm beach setting behind him.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Powerful Teamwork Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles pose together in this printable coloring page, with Sonic extending an open hand in front and Knuckles raising his large fists behind him. Their oversized shoes overlap curved ground lines inside a rectangular border. The coloring sheet offers broad glove and shoe areas alongside smaller cuffs, facial features, and floating circles.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Best Friends Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Sonic and Knuckles side by side, with Sonic lifting one large shoe toward the viewer while Knuckles stands with both fists lowered. Sonic's sweeping quills contrast with Knuckles's hanging head spines. Thick character outlines and an empty background keep the coloring sheet focused on their gloves, shoes, and expressions.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Running By Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles run side by side beside the water in this printable coloring page, pumping their fists and lifting their large shoes mid-stride. Gentle wave lines, a curving shoreline, distant mountains, and a round sun keep the background open around the racing pair.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Pointing In Simple Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles point at each other inside a simple room in this printable coloring page, standing on opposite sides of a small table and chair. A four-pane window sits on the back wall, while loose rectangular sheets lie across the foreground floor.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Running By River Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles race along a winding river in this printable coloring page, leaning forward with clenched fists as their shoes pass over the water. Curved ripples, small splashes, scattered rocks, rounded trees, and distant hills surround the two running characters.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Standing Calmly In Hallway Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles stand calmly beside each other in a hallway in this printable coloring page, facing forward with relaxed arms and slight smiles. Long floorboards and angled ceiling lines lead toward the back of the corridor, with open doorways on both sides.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Observing On Snowy Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles observes the landscape from a snowy hill in this printable coloring page, standing with both gloved hands lowered and his feet planted apart. Falling flakes and droplets fill the sky around rounded clouds, simple trees, rolling slopes, and small mounds of snow.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Resting In Virtual World Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles rests on a floating platform in a virtual world in this printable coloring page, leaning back with one shoe stretched across the blocky surface. Cubes, pixel-shaped trees, looping tracks, and a fragmented circular symbol surround the platform, adding geometric details to the scene.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Reaching In Sky City Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles reach upward while leaping above Sky City in this printable coloring page, with Sonic making a peace sign and Knuckles raising a fist. Curved bridges, cylindrical towers, exposed gears, and billowing clouds fill the elaborate cityscape below their dangling shoes.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Running In Waterfall Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles run through shallow water near a waterfall in this printable coloring page, lifting their shoes amid small splashes along a rocky stream. Tall palm trees flank the cascading water, while angular boulders and leafy bushes frame the racing pair.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Watching In Adventure Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles watches with folded arms beside Sonic in this printable coloring page, standing on a winding path through a sunny adventure landscape with tropical scenery. Palm trees, jagged mountains, rocky outcrops, bushes, and a large sun surround the two confident characters.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Observing In Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles observes the town with his arms folded beside Sonic in this printable coloring page, near a wooden bench on a street lined with buildings. Arched doors and windows, a curved streetlamp, small bushes, and a tall clock tower provide architectural details behind them.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Standing On Cloud Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles stand on a puffy cloud in this printable coloring page, with Sonic giving a thumbs-up and Knuckles raising one gloved fist. A large outlined circle rises behind their heads, and curling flourishes extend from the cloud around their oversized shoes.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Reaching In Running Track Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles reaches one open hand forward while sprinting along a running track in this printable coloring page, with his other fist drawn back beside him. The enlarged sole of his leading shoe and converging track lines emphasize the pose against a simple cloudy horizon.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Standing In Desert Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles stand in a sunny desert level in this printable coloring page, posing with a thumbs-up and a raised fist beneath floating rings. Cacti, cracked rock formations, rolling dunes, and scattered pebbles surround their broad gloves and large shoes.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Looking Excited In A Palm Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles look excited among tall palm trees in this printable coloring page, with Sonic spreading his arms and Knuckles lifting a clenched fist. Layered trunks, pointed fronds, rounded bushes, distant mountains, and foreground rocks create a dense tropical forest setting.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Waving Happily On A Loop Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles wave happily from a winding valley path in this printable coloring page, standing side by side beneath a sun with long straight rays. Rounded trees, distant mountains, small stones, and scattered grass tufts add simple landscape details around the smiling pair.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Spinning Happily On A Loop Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles spin happily inside a large circular loop in this printable coloring page, spreading their arms with their feet lifted above the valley floor. Divided bands outline the loop, while rounded bushes, small trees, and rolling hills surround its broad opening.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Walking Proudly Near A Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles walk proudly near a mountain in this printable coloring page, striding side by side with their gloved fists lowered and confident smiles. Three snow-tipped peaks rise behind them, with broad clouds and scattered boulders completing the open mountain landscape.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Posing Happily In Green Hill Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles pose happily in Green Hill Zone in this printable coloring page, showing a thumbs-up and a raised fist in front of palm trees. A tall loop, checker-patterned hills, clouds, and small ground markings add familiar shapes around the two characters.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Looking Excited Near Rolling Hills Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles look excited near rolling hills in this printable coloring page, lifting their feet as Sonic waves and Knuckles raises both fists. A winding trail, rounded bushes, a few grass tufts, and two broad clouds create the simple valley background.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Walking Happily In A Cheerful Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles walk happily along a flower-lined path in this printable coloring page, smiling as their large shoes swing forward through a cheerful valley. Tall rounded trees, leafy stems, layered hills, clouds, and a partly hidden sun fill the scene around them.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Standing Bravely On A Bright Hillside Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles stand bravely on a bright hillside in this printable coloring page, holding their fists up with confident expressions and their feet apart. Smooth rolling slopes, rounded bushes, distant trees, and simple clouds provide broad spaces around the two bold character outlines.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Resting Peacefully On A Bright Island Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles rests peacefully on a tiny island in this printable coloring page, reclining with closed eyes and both shoes stretched out in front of him. Three leaning palm trees, scattered pebbles, and curved water lines surround the compact island against a largely open background.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Celebrating Happily Near A Mountain Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles celebrate happily near a mountain in this printable coloring page, jumping with raised fists as Knuckles grins with his eyes closed. Their bent knees and oversized shoes stand out above a landscape of pointed snowy peaks and broad rounded clouds.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Smiling Happily Near Palm Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: Sonic and Knuckles smile happily near two palm trees in this printable coloring page, posing with Sonic's thumb raised and Knuckles holding up one fist. Their gloves, shoe straps, and quills provide character details beneath the long fronds and rounded coconuts overhead.

pages.title: Sonic Knuckles Waving Happily In A Bright Island Zone Coloring Page
pages.description: Knuckles waves both hands on a bright island in this printable coloring page, smiling with his feet set apart on a small patch of land. Palm trees, pointed rocks, a tiny leafy plant, scattered pebbles, and a spiky sun frame the surrounding water.
